Firewall block action signed and approved; rule 'BLOCK-C2-INC0601' applied.
Replay of firewall block executed to ensure rule propagation across cluster.
Affected workstation WS-IT-101 isolated from network and full malware scan initiated.
Scan completed; no malware found. Host hardening steps performed (removal of suspicious tools, configuration review).
Helpdesk user account credentials reset to eliminate potential compromise.
Post‑remediation monitoring confirmed no further malicious activity from the IP or on the host.
